item: Duct tape carried in suit pockets on every EVA
rationale: After an air hose tore on an ATV rail edge during EVA 01 and was cut, patched and pressure-tested in the field, the mission brief's lesson is to carry duct tape and a hose repair kit in suit pockets on every EVA. The crew's report describes only the patching of the hose and does not say what material was used.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 536-541, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column
